acceptance_criteria: The function correctly counts lines that are not empty (i.e., lines with only whitespace or empty strings).
Empty lines (e.g., lines with only spaces or tabs) are not counted.
The function handles edge cases such as empty input or input with only whitespace.

text.description: The input text to analyze for non-empty lines.

objective: Count the number of non-empty lines in a supplied text input.

line_count.description: The number of non-empty lines in the input text.
